question: At the more mature epoch20 checkpoint, can literal dual CFG improve perturbation specificity and DE recovery without degrading the other paper metrics?
motivation: Epoch15-to20 paired primary score improves0.03222 [0.01018,0.05720], mainly PDS; PDCorr and DE remain below paper. Earlier epoch10 CFG benefits were small/inconclusive. Revisit inference on the new checkpoint before changing training.
metrics: all9 on clamp_min0; raw predictions retained; fixed cell indices and noise across cases
comparison_to_periodic_cache: Periodic epoch20 used cap32/B32; it is not a matched-noise baseline for these cap16/B16 cases. Include a fresh ordinary reference here.
ordinary_role: diagnostic reference only; excluded from eventual formal positive-CFG selection
scope: Interim validation-only screen, no full refinement or final setting selection, no test expression. Main original training continues unchanged.

if_boundary_best: Review boundary behavior before any final selection; do not assume the initial finite scale grid establishes a global optimum.
